items.context: You have joined a swimming club in your town.
items.prompt: Tell us why you like swimming and when you can come to the pool. Write in sentences. Use 20–30 words.

b2.text: I like swimming because it is good for my back and it helps me relax. I can come to the pool on Tuesday evenings and on Saturday mornings.

note.en: A simple connector to give your reason.
note.es: Conector sencillo para dar el motivo.

note.en: Use 'on' with days and add a time of day to be precise.
note.es: Usa «on» con los días y añade el momento del día para ser preciso.

c.text: I enjoy swimming not only because it is good for my back, but also because it helps me switch off. I am free on Tuesday evenings and Saturday mornings.

annotations.quote: not only because it is good for my back, but also because

note.en: 'Not only ... but also' joins two reasons in one sentence.
note.es: «Not only ... but also» une dos motivos en una sola frase.

note.en: A phrasal verb meaning to stop thinking about work or worries.

items.context: You have joined an English class at a language school.
items.prompt: Tell us why you want to learn English and what you do in your free time. Write in sentences. Use 20–30 words.

b2.text: I want to learn English because I need it for my job. In my free time I like cooking, watching films and going for long walks with my dog.

annotations.quote: because I need it for my job

note.es: «Because» da un motivo claro y sencillo.

annotations.quote: cooking, watching films and going for long walks

note.en: After 'like', use the -ing form for each activity in the list.
note.es: Tras «like», usa la forma -ing en cada actividad de la lista.

c.text: My main reason for learning English is that I need it at work. When I have some spare time, I enjoy cooking, catching up on films and walking my dog.

annotations.quote: My main reason for learning English is that

note.en: A noun phrase + 'is that' gives the reason in a more varied way.
note.es: Sintagma nominal + «is that» da el motivo de forma más variada.

note.en: 'Catch up on' means to watch or do things you have missed.
note.es: «Catch up on» es ponerse al día con lo que te has perdido.
